summaries.plain:
Implemented and validated the CSV UTF-8 export fix, including coverage for names and non-ASCII data, byte-level inspection, Ruff, and the full test suite.

Billing refactors now use transactional `account.apply_credit()` calls to clear invoice balances, clamp credits so finalized balances cannot become negative, and include type-only helper/ledger annotations. Invoice generators are materialized, discounts convert safely via `Decimal(str(...))`, and timestamps are timezone-aware. The full 318-test suite and mypy pass with four skips. A legacy discrepancy remains in `test_apply_credit_after_refund` (`87.50` expected versus `90.00` actual), likely involving credit-memo/refund application ordering.

Payment-method work added a `payment_method_factory` fixture; all 63 payment tests pass. Expired bank details should remain masked in every payment-method response while preserving safe metadata.

Test performance improved through rollback-scoped fixtures, shared factories, batched customer setup, and a frozen UTC clock, bringing the full suite to roughly 15–18 seconds.

Resolved an intermittent invoice-sync idempotency race: completion now updates only when both idempotency key and invoice ID match, with a concurrent regression test confirming both requests receive `INV-2024-0001`. Validation passed 126 tests with three skips, integration tests, Ruff, formatting, and load testing with eight original submissions and 192 replays. External payment-stub state is cleaned between tests. This was committed as `fix-billing-idempotency-race`.

Current work has only begun investigating invoice listing. The API route `ledgerly/api/invoices.py::list_invoices` accepts only `db`, returns all invoices as a bare list, and delegates to `InvoiceService.list_invoices()`. The service currently selects all invoices ordered by newest `created_at` using `session.scalars(statement).all()`; no changes have been made yet.
